environment.model: deepseek-v4-pro (mutable server-side alias, likely 0813 checkpoint on observation date)

mechanism.replayRule: assistant messages WITH tool calls have their reasoning_content replayed to subsequent requests; plain-text assistant messages drop reasoning
mechanism.anchorMassDefinition: sum of replayed reasoning chars across the template's tool-call-bearing assistant messages
mechanism.cleaningSideEffect: template cleaning (removing failed call/result pairs) also removes replay eligibility; project2 template 5178 chars/7 steps raw -> 3533/7 after cleaning

templateBaselines.note: structurally superior (steps/replay ratio) but wins on no measured style axis; kept as local candidate

probeResults.methodology: one model request per trial; first durable assistant/message triggers cancel; first-line family classification (we/lets/let-me/user/i/other) plus body we/letMe counts and first-message tool-call count
conclusions: 9/9 zero let-me across both templates: replayed anchor mass fully suppresses let-me degeneration
first-line family is governed by follow-up prompt shape, not by the template
replayed-slice we density (not step count) covaries with clone body we usage (exploratory, n=4)

budgetNote: post-price-hike methodology: Project2-class full evaluation (~12 CNY/round) suspended; entire round cost = 4 roll attempts + 9 single-request probes
excluded: no full reasoning text, no session IDs, no request IDs, no workspace paths
